clue.text: Crazy cricketers

definitions.meaning: a cricketer who ... is at the crease wielding the bat; batsmen are often called ...

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: slang for mad, and players who wield the bat in cricket, the English bat-and-ball game.

clue.text: Brazen redhead interrupts a party

indicators.note: one piece breaking into the middle of another is placed inside it

parts.note: a bash is an informal word for a party
the head, or first letter, of red

explanation.surface: A flame-haired guest barges rudely into a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redhead' is read as the head of 'red', its first letter R, which goes into BASH.
explanation.definitionFit: Brazen and brash are synonyms, both describing loud, shameless self-assertion.

clue.text: The groom is a well, balanced chap

parts.note: someone well-balanced is mentally stable
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A bridegroom is praised as a steady, sensible fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: The groom looks like the man at a wedding, but here it is one who tends horses.
explanation.definitionFit: A groom is a person employed to look after horses, which is the job of a stable worker.

clue.text: Signal from union leader in church

indicators.note: the union's leading letter sits inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A union boss in church gives a sign to begin.
explanation.definitionFit: A cue is a signal to an actor or performer to begin speaking or acting.

clue.text: Painkiller described in German cipher message

annotationWithheld.why: Painkiller described in German cipher message (7): the wordplay (EIN inside CODE) gives CODEINE, a painkiller, but the answer held is CADDICE, which neither definition nor wordplay supports
annotationWithheld.clue: Painkiller described in German cipher message

clue.text: Fast-talking ensures speedy postal service

definitions.meaning: rapid speech read as an ... of words
a postal option that delivers mail faster than usual

explanation.definitionFit: A playful sense of rapid speech, and the literal name of a fast postal service.

clue.text: Cut off caller with psychological kink

definitions.meaning: to put the phone down on someone, ending the call

explanation.definitionFit: Ending a phone call abruptly, and a noun for an emotional fixation or neurosis.

clue.text: Boss determined to display audio receiver

parts.note: the head is the boss of an organisation
set on something means determined

explanation.surface: A manager is resolved to show off some new headphones.
explanation.definitionFit: Headphones with a microphone, worn to receive sound, are a common audio device.

clue.text: Acknowledged that George initially pontificated

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it follows

parts.note: to pontificate is to hold forth pompously, as in ranting

explanation.surface: It was conceded that George was the first to sound off.
explanation.definitionFit: To grant a point is to concede or admit it, so the past form means admitted.

clue.text: Fish and leaf beet served in lager

indicators.note: one item placed within another, as food is served in a dish

parts.note: Pils is short for Pilsner, a pale lager
chard is a leafy vegetable, also called leaf beet

explanation.surface: A meal of fish and greens is washed down with lager.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilchards are small oily sea fish of the herring family, often sold tinned.

clue.text: Heavenly home, there's a small drawback

indicators.note: drawback is read as draw back: the synonym for draw is turned round

parts.note: to draw is to drag or pull

explanation.surface: Paradise is lovely, though it comes with one slight disadvantage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawback' looks like one word meaning a snag, but it splits into two: a synonym for 'draw' followed by the reversal signal 'back'.
explanation.definitionFit: In Norse mythology Asgard is the realm of the gods, a heaven above the mortal world.

clue.text: Co-operate in drama, dance production

parts.note: a play is a drama
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Working together on a stage show and choreographed number.
explanation.definitionFit: To play ball is an idiom meaning to go along with or co-operate with others.

clue.text: Gunman will shoot, despite dire punishment

parts.note: the gunman is referred to as he
'll is the contracted form of will
to fire is to shoot

explanation.surface: An armed man means to open fire, whatever the terrible penalty.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Gunman will shoot' as the sentence 'He'll fire'.
explanation.definitionFit: The fires of hell are traditionally the eternal torment awaiting the damned.

clue.text: Exchange a whip

definitions.meaning: to swap one thing for another
a thin flexible cane or rod used for whipping

explanation.definitionFit: A verb meaning to swap, and a noun for a slender rod used for beating.

clue.text: Lexicon for barristers

definitions.meaning: a dictionary, here the well-known ... dictionary

explanation.definitionFit: A famous British dictionary publisher, and the rooms of a set of barristers, the courtroom lawyers in Britain.

clue.text: Obliging inclination to offer royal annuities

parts.note: civil means polite and accommodating
a list is a lean or tilt, as of a ship

explanation.surface: A courteous tendency to provide the monarchy with yearly payments.
explanation.walkthrough: The Civil List was the annual sum Parliament granted the British royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: The parliamentary allowance paid each year to the British monarch and family for official expenses.

clue.text: Can the German light fires with it?

parts.note: a tin is a can
der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: Asking whether a German can start a blaze.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry flammable material used for kindling, used to get a blaze going.

clue.text: No riotous assembly is disreputable

indicators.note: the letters are put together afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: A peaceful gathering is said to have a poor reputation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' signals that NO RIOTOUS is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Notorious means famous for something bad, the same as being of ill repute.

clue.text: Sailors tucked into meat. It's fresh

indicators.note: one piece goes inside another, as sailors tuck into a meal

parts.note: veal is calf meat
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Sailors hungrily eat some meat, which is fresh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucked into' reads as sailors eating the meat, but it is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernal means of the spring, hence new, youthful and fresh.

clue.text: About to ride a bike to aid conservation

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to cycle is to ride a bicycle

explanation.surface: Someone sets out on a bicycle as their bit for the environment.
explanation.definitionFit: Reprocessing used materials helps conserve resources, the core idea of environmental conservation.

clue.text: Intimate enabled medic to get work

parts.note: let means allowed or enabled
DR is the abbreviation for doctor
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A close friend allowed a doctor to start a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intimate' is a verb here, to hint, not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: To intimate is to hint or reveal casually, the same as mentioning something in passing.

clue.text: They turn out English champions

parts.note: victors are winners or champions

explanation.surface: English winners are the ones who put on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who evict throw tenants out of a property, which is turning them out.

clue.text: Hindu queen embraced by Scotsman from the Middle East

indicators.note: one piece held inside the arms of another

parts.note: Ian is a typical Scottish man's name
a rani is a Hindu queen or a raja's wife

explanation.surface: An Indian queen is hugged by a Scot from the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: Iran is a Middle Eastern country, so a person or thing from there comes from that region.

clue.text: Kitty Fisher found what she lost

definitions.text: Kitty Fisher found what she lost

parts.words: Kitty Fisher found what she lost
parts.note: from the nursery rhyme in which Lucy ... lost her pocket and Kitty Fisher found it, so the item lost is named after its loser

explanation.definitionFit: Lucy Locket of the nursery rhyme is the one who lost her pocket, so her surname names the missing person.

clue.text: Fantasising whilst making marinade (2,1.5) 231 Reaching position of authority

indicators.note: the letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: Daydreaming while preparing a marinade for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: The text after the count is a fragment of another clue run into this one by the scan.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a dream is to be lost in a fantasy or reverie.

clue.text: Could possibly meet an American Indian

parts.note: may expresses possibility

explanation.surface: Perhaps one might run into a Native American.
explanation.definitionFit: The Maya are an Indigenous people of Central America, so one of them is an American Indian.

clue.text: Reaching position of authority

annotationWithheld.why: Reaching position of authority (2,6): as held this is a fragment also run into 21-across by the scan; no wordplay for IN CHARGE accounts for Reaching

clue.text: One fellow and no more? Would it were so!

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one
only means no more than

explanation.surface: A lonely chap sighs that he wishes things were different.
explanation.definitionFit: If only is an exclamation wishing that something were the case.

clue.text: Protective covering one needs to step around

definitions.text: Protective covering one needs to step around

parts.words: Protective covering one needs to step around
parts.note: a hard cover fitted to the front of a work boot, guarding the part of the foot that leads every step

explanation.definitionFit: A reinforced cap over the front of a shoe or boot protects the foot from heavy objects.

clue.text: Longing for some witty entertainment

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used

explanation.surface: Craving a bit of clever amusement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' tells you to take part of WITTY ENTERTAINMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A yen is a strong desire or yearning for something.

clue.text: Nips back for brief trip

indicators.note: the word is read from right to left

explanation.surface: Someone pops back for a short outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A spin is a short drive or ride for pleasure, a little trip out.
